candidate: Jingxi Zero-Carbon Intelligent Computing Industrial Base (京西零碳智算产业基地), parcel GY25-159, Qijie village, Shacheng town / Ertaizi village, Tumu town, Huailai County, Zhangjiakou, Hebei: campus locator for the data-centre development
method: The selected point is the area centroid of the red-line land-use boundary (用地范围线) of parcel GY25-159 computed from the five boundary-corner coordinates printed on the official design-scheme site plan (京西零碳智算产业基地项目建设工程设计方案总平面图, sheet '彩色总平面图', scale 1:1000), which states its coordinate system as the 2000 national geodetic coordinate system (坐标系：2000国家大地坐标系) and its height datum as the 1985 national height datum. The printed values are Gauss-Kruger grid coordinates with the zone number 39 prefixed to Y (3-degree zone 39, central meridian 117 E). They were converted with pyproj 3.7.1 from EPSG:4527 (CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger zone 39, with the 39 prefix) to EPSG:4490 (CGCS2000 geographic); CGCS2000 and WGS84 agree to well under a metre at this scale, so no further transformation was applied. The polygon area and centroid were computed with shapely 2.1.1 in the projected grid. An independent Esri World Imagery EPSG:4326 export was used only to check the frame and the parcel's surroundings.

frame_check.observation: Drawn on the export, the computed parcel covers open land whose north edge follows the south side of the east-west road, whose west edge follows the east wall of an existing walled compound of long data-centre-type buildings, and which lies north-east of the Beijing-Zhangjiakou high-speed railway. This matches the publicity's location sheet (local hl79-72041-img1.jpg), which outlines the project on vacant land east of existing industrial land with buildings under construction, north of 学苑街 and the Beijing-Zhangjiakou high-speed railway and west of 广通路, and the site plan, which labels the western neighbour 怀来大数据科技产业园项目 (Huailai big-data science and technology industrial park project). The centroid falls inside the parcel on open land.
frame_check.manual_check_accuracy: manual visual comparison on imagery of about 0.8 m per pixel and unstated accuracy

scope_and_uncertainty: The point locates the Jingxi Zero-Carbon Intelligent Computing Industrial Base parcel (the campus of the planned 1#-3# data-centre buildings) by its red-line centroid. It is not a building footprint, entrance or construction extent; the planned buildings are spread over the whole 400 m x 200 m parcel. The printed corners are design-plan coordinates of unstated survey accuracy; the 1.4 m2 area agreement indicates internally consistent values, and the projection change introduces no material error. Horizontal uncertainty is left unquantified.
